testCases.title: Verify product information is displayed correctly
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
expectedResults: The product information (image, name, description, price, category badge, brand badge) is displayed correctly on the product detail page.

testCases.title: Verify related products section is displayed
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
Scroll down to the section with related products.
expectedResults: A section with related products is displayed below the main product information on the product detail page.

testCases.title: Verify related products are clickable
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
Locate the section with related products.
Click on each of the related products.
expectedResults: Each related product is clickable and navigates to its respective detail page.
